name: Chinatsu
source:
She has rather cold eyes and carries the image of a cool beauty but she is also very sensitive and quick to switch between these two aspects of her personality. She is a mysterious person who pops up throughout the Tokiwa village leaving warnings and predictions.

[spoiler]Chinatsu is actually [url=https://vndb.org/c3129]Ojou[/url]'s fragment of emotions for love and knowledge. [url=https://vndb.org/c12876]Kako[/url] made a pact with Chinatsu after Chinatsu arrived in Tokiwa. Both of them can switch personae at any time as Chinatsu's control over Kako is limited.[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?product_code=43]MangaGamer[/url] and [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/922090-suika-as/faqs/58095]neo-X-saga's Walkthrough[/url]]
